verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a KYC/AML compliance platform. Selfie-to-document matching with liveness detection is a plausible onboarding capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, risk scoring, case management, transaction monitoring and webhooks. Nothing documents selfie checks, face matching, or defenses against printed photos, screens or replayed video.
